beats.caption: What if the same data arrived 7 days late? 5 aircraft that were fixed in time now fail, 3 of them in the air.
At Aravalli alone, that's 0 failures with on time data and 5 when it's 7 days late.
Over 10 runs it's 1.2 failures with on time data against 8.8 with late data. Readiness barely changes. What you lose is aircraft.
